problem:
A tank initially holds $600\,\text{gal}$ of a brine (salt-water) solution containing $18\,\text{lb}$ of salt.
A brine solution containing $0.02\,\text{lb}$ of salt per gallon flows into the tank at a rate of $15\,\text{gal/min},$ while the completely mixed brine leaves the tank at a rate of $20\,\text{gal/min}.$ Which differential equation best describes the amount of salt $Q,$ in pounds, in the tank $t$ minutes after the inflow begins?
